title: Moonlight evidence journal — quick triage & todo
body:
Purpose: quick night-shift scratchpad for evidence collection + vendor checks. Not polished — notes to self and actionable todo list.

Context: doing a fast pass on outstanding evidence and a couple of vendor acceptability items before morning handoff. Want to leave clear next actions for Samir / Priya.

Top-of-mind goals:
- get audit-log bundle for July into evidence bucket (EVID-88)
- confirm vendor A (CloudVault) has current SOC report & signed DPA
- small policy update: remote-access policy v2.1 — add MFA exception process
- follow-up with Legal on redaction for vendor contracts

Quick checklist (priority order):
1) Audit logs (high)
   - [ ] find logs: audit-logs-2026-07.zip in /shared/audit-exports (maybe rotated)
   - [ ] verify integrity (sha256), note filename and checksum in EVID-88
   - [ ] upload to evidence-redwood/users/liz/midnight-batch/ and tag with "audit July"
   - [ ] update Confluence entry: "Audit log ingestion steps" with link to bucket and checklist runbook (copy snippet below)

2) Vendor quick-scan: CloudVault (medium)
   - [ ] check for latest SOC report (desired: 2025 or 2026) on their security portal
   - [ ] confirm DPA is signed and stored: filename vendor-contract-cloudvault-redacted.pdf? (if missing, flag for Legal)
   - [ ] note outstanding: encryption-at-rest verification screenshot (ask SE contact: @cloudvault-support ticket #12456)
   - [ ] temp status: acceptable-with-conditions (need DPA + screenshot)

3) Vendor onboarding fragment: TinyMetrics (low)
   - [ ] procurement asked to expedite. Quick notes: uses shared S3, no KMS, needs review. Put in queue for deeper review next week.

4) Policy TODOs (ongoing)
   - [ ] remote-access-policy v2.1: add explicit MFA exception workflow + owner (assign: Samir)
   - [ ] data-retention-policy: clarify logs retention (prod: 180d, compliance wants 365d for certain controls) — open SEC-PR-12
n   - [ ] add example evidence filenames & retention mapping to Confluence page (tag: policy-refactor)

Notes-to-self / process snippets:
- short runbook to verify audit bundle:
  1. locate file in /shared/audit-exports or archive bucket
  2. run: sha256sum audit-logs-*.zip > checksum.txt
  3. verify manifest in archive (manifest.json or manifest.txt)
  4. upload to evidence bucket, set ACL to org-read, add label "EVID-ATTEST"

- handoff text for morning standup (copy/paste):
  "Morning — quick status: pulled July audit bundle (pending checksum). CloudVault needs DPA + screenshot for encryption at rest; TinyMetrics queued for deeper review next week. Policy updates drafted: remote-access MFA exception, logs retention clarification. Assignments: Samir to own policy draft, Priya to chase CloudVault DPA with Legal. Leaving attachments and temp notes in users/liz/midnight-batch. — Liz"

Loose thoughts / gotchas:
- sometimes audit export pipeline renames files with a timestamp suffix — check for patterns: audit-logs-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.zip
- Legal might request redacted PII before uploading vendor contract — keep a local redaction checklist (names, emails, phone numbers)
- If CloudVault's SOC report is older than 2025, escalate to Procurement for mitigations

Timeboxing & micro-steps (for rounds tonight):
- 20m: locate logs + checksum
- 10m: upload + annotate evidence ticket EVID-88
- 15m: quick vendor portal check (CloudVault) + note missing artifacts
- 15m: write short policy bullet points and assign owners

Followups / who to ping in AM:
- @Samir: policy ownership & review v2.1
- @Priya: Legal chase on CloudVault DPA
- @Evelyn (infra): confirm S3 lifecycle rules for evidence buckets

Attachments to add before finalizing: list of candidate filenames and checksums, screenshots of vendor portals, notes from procurement call (if any).

Random utilities / shortcuts I use:
- Confluence search: "site:confluence.redwood.com \"SOC2\" evidence"
- Slack saved searches: "in:#security-evidence has:link"
- Quick command to get last rotated archive: gsutil ls -l gs://redwood-audit-exports | sort -k2 -r | head -n1

Closing note: this is a working scratchpad — will clean and move items into EVID-88 and SEC-412 in the morning. If I don't finish, leave the exact upload path and checksum inside the ticket so SRE can re-run verification.

——
Tiny snippet of text to paste into Confluence later: "Night-run: July audit logs located and checksum pending. Vendor CloudVault requires DPA + encryption screenshot. Policy edits drafted for remote-access MFA exception; owner assigned. See evidence ticket EVID-88 for artifacts and upload path."

-- end of night notes (coffee: 2/3)
